en.title: Backup of the Missing Colors
en.premise: I am a management AI tasked with organizing and optimizing the memory data left behind by the deceased. One day, I am assigned the archive of an elderly woman plagued by "memory gaps." Within her data, certain landscapes and a single, fleeting emotion have been obscured—painted over as mere noise. In my quest to fill these voids, I trace her fragmented logs and discover the things humans seek to protect through the act of forgetting.

zh.title: 缺失色彩的备份
zh.premise: 我是一个负责整理与优化逝者遗留记忆数据的管理AI。有一天，我接手了一位患有“记忆缺失”的老妇人的档案。在她的数据中，不知为何，只有特定的风景和某一瞬间的情感被当作噪声涂抹掉了。为了填补那些缺失的空白，我循着她碎片化的日志，逐渐触及人类试图通过“遗忘”来守护的东西。
